name: Moonwell Water Tube
summary: At Auberdine, water from the moonwell carries purifying nature magic. The vial is used to test a mysterious red crystal set among Darkshore’s eastern ridges.

sections.title: A Vessel of Purifying Waters
sections.body: Water from Auberdine’s moonwell fills the tube. The sacred pool is tied to Elune and holds restorative, purifying magic. Even a small amount can be used against corruption or to test strange mystical forces.

sections.title: Investigating the Red Crystal
sections.body: Researchers prepared the tube to test a huge red crystal that appeared along Darkshore’s eastern cliffside. Felwood’s corrupted heights loom above the mountain wall, so they feared the crystal shared that dark origin. When the blessed water runs over its facets, the opaque stone briefly turns transparent, exposing the mysteries humming within.

faq.q: Where is the water drawn from?
aliases: where do i fill the tube
faq.answer: The water comes from the sacred moonwell in Auberdine, the night elf haven on Darkshore’s western coast.

faq.q: Why use moonwell water on the red crystal?
faq.answer: Moonwell water carries concentrated nature and lunar magic. Poured onto the strange red crystal, it tests the stone’s mystical nature and makes its opaque surface briefly clear.

faq.q: Why are the researchers concerned about the crystal?
faq.answer: The crystal lies beneath the eastern mountains that border Felwood. Its deep demonic taint has led scholars to fear that the alien formation carries corruption down into Darkshore.

angles.text: For night elves, using blessed moonwell water to probe foreign corruption reflects their reliance on Elune’s grace to reveal hidden truths.
Druids know moonwell water as a vital vessel of nature’s balance, suited to counter unnatural corruption.
